title: Patch: Your Table's stats name the right kind of card (Spells are never Unbreakable)
plan_in_issue:
## Goal

The "Your table" stats (`apps/web/src/stats/`) change as follows. This is presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7):

- `destroyed` and `defeated` count a death only when the other seat caused it.
- Unbreakable, Glass Cannon and Workhorse name only Units. Unbreakable also skips Indestructible Units and Units under the plays floor.
- Medic credits Lifesteal hits.
- Hot Streak, The Record and Ride or Die read the wins.
- Survivor gets a new line.
- A lunge on a Spell plays a new stage animation, `cast`, and a lunge on a Trap plays `trap`.
- Comeback Kid becomes Lucky Charm.

All of it sits under ruling R2648000, with tests named after it.

## Steps

1. **`apps/web/src/stats/track.ts`**
   - **Imports.** Add `import { opponentOf } from "@jackioh/shared";`, and add `PlayerId` to the existing type import.
   - **`countEvent`.** Delete the `destroyed` block. Its doc comment becomes: "plays, draws, Radiant changes, turns and the viewer's Traps fired".
   - **After `countAllured`,** add:
   ```ts
   /** R2648000: the seat whose side shows `instanceId` in the first of `views` that does; null for none or the sentinel (R97). */
   function seatOf(views: readonly (PlayerView | null)[], instanceId: string | null): PlayerId | null {
     if (instanceId === null || instanceId === HIDDEN_ID) return null;
     for (const view of views) {
       if (view === null) continue;
       for (const side of [view.you, view.opponent]) {
         if (cardsOnSide(side).some((card) => card.instanceId === instanceId)) return side.player;
       }
     }
     return null;
   }

   /**
    * R2648000: a death counts (`destroyed` for the viewer's card, `defeated` for the opponent's) only when the
    * seat across from its owner caused it: its `killerId` names a card on that side (in the view before the
    * batch, else this one), or the last `cardPlayed`, `activated`, `trapFired` or `attackDeclared` before it in
    * the batch was that seat's (a destroy Spell names no killer, R89). Never after a `crumbled` of the same
    * card (Brittle), nor when the owner's side acted last with no killer of the other's (a Tribute, a
    * Sacrifice, its own sweeper), nor with no actor and no killer.
    */
   export function countDeaths(log: GameLog, view: PlayerView, fresh: readonly GameEvent[], before: PlayerView | null): GameLog {
     const views = [before, view];
     const crumbled = new Set<string>();
     let actor: PlayerId | null = null;
     let next = log;
     for (const event of fresh) {
       if (event.type === "cardPlayed" || event.type === "activated") {
         actor = event.player;
       } else if (event.type === "trapFired") {
         actor = event.controller;
       } else if (event.type === "attackDeclared") {
         actor = seatOf(views, event.attackerId);
       } else if (event.type === "crumbled") {
         crumbled.add(event.instanceId);
       } else if (event.type === "destroyed") {
         const id = readable(event.defId);
         const foe = opponentOf(event.owner);
         if (id === null || crumbled.has(event.instanceId)) continue;
         if (seatOf(views, event.killerId) !== foe && actor !== foe) continue;
         next = logWith(next, event.owner === view.viewer ? "destroyed" : "defeated", id);
       }
     }
     return next;
   }
   ```
   - **`countHealing`.**
     - Add two branches before the `healed` branch:
       - `else if (event.type === "attackDeclared") { source = defIdOn([view.you], event.attackerId); }`
       - `else if (event.type === "damage") { source = defIdOn([view.you], event.sourceId); }`
     - Add a doc sentence: under R2648000, the viewer's attacker, or the viewer's card that dealt the damage, becomes the source, and any other attack or damage clears it.
   - **`observe`.** Its return becomes `countWin(countHealing(countHits(countDeaths(countAllured(next, view, fresh), view, fresh, before), view, fresh, before), view, fresh), view, fresh)`.
   - **Header, line 1.** Append: "R2648000: a death counts only when the other seat caused it; a Lifesteal hit credits its heal."

3. **`apps/web/src/stats/showcase.ts`**
   - **Import.** It becomes `import { hasKeyword, type CardDefs, type KeywordKind } from "@jackioh/shared";`.
   - **After `showable`,** add:
   ```ts
   /** R2648000: the card's catalog type is Unit. */
   function isUnit(id: string): boolean {
     return CATALOG[id]?.type === "Unit";
   }

   /** R2648000: either face of the card prints one of `kinds`. */
   function prints(id: string, ...kinds: KeywordKind[]): boolean {
     const def = CATALOG[id];
     return def !== undefined && kinds.some((kind) => hasKeyword(def.base.keywords, kind) || hasKeyword(def.radiant.keywords, kind));
   }

   /** R2648000: a lunge is a Unit's or an Animated card's; a Spell or Field Spell casts, a Trap or Field Trap is revealed. Anything else is kept. */
   export function animationFor(defId: string, wanted: StageAnimation): StageAnimation {
     const type = CATALOG[defId]?.type;
     if (wanted !== "lunge" || type === undefined || type === "Unit" || prints(defId, "Animated", "Animated on your turn")) return wanted;
     return type === "Trap" || type === "Field Trap" ? "trap" : "cast";
   }
   ```
   - **`column` and `topShare`.** `column`'s `score` takes `(counts: CardCounters, id: string)` and is called as `score(counts, id)`. `topShare`'s `part` takes the same and is called as `part(counts, id)`.
   - **`SHOWCASE_KEYS`.** `"comebackKid"` becomes `"luckyCharm"`, in the same position.

     - rideOrDie: `topShare(stats, (c) => c.survived, (c) => c.playedInWin)`, with the line `t("still standing at the end of {n} of the {m} wins you played it in", { n, m })`.
     - workhorse: `tallied(ranked(column(stats, (c, id) => (isUnit(id) ? c.damageDealt : 0)))[0], …same meta…, (n) => t("dealt {n} damage", { n }))`.
     - comebackKid: becomes `key: "luckyCharm"` and `title: () => t("Lucky Charm")`; nothing else changes.
     - hotStreak: its card is `stats.bestStreak > 0 ? topCard(stats, "playedInWin")?.id : undefined`.
     - `return out;` becomes `return out.map((stat) => ({ ...stat, animation: animationFor(stat.cardId, stat.animation) }));`.
   - **Header.** Add an R2648000 line.

- [ ] The new and updated tests pass.
- [ ] The whole web suite passes, `i18n.test.ts` included.

## Risks

- **Hidden information (R97).** `seatOf` and `defIdOn` read only `cardsOnSide`, which leaves out face-down cards, the opponent's hand and the sentinel.
- **Old totals are not migrated.** This is the issue's rule.
- **The first screen (R1584000).** `showcase.ts` must import only types from `showcaseStage.ts`. `animationFor` uses `showcase.ts`'s own `CATALOG`.
- **More tests may break.** Any tally that expects The Record, Unbreakable with fewer than 5 plays, or Hot Streak without wins will fail. Run the whole suite and fix the data.
- **TypeScript.** The exhaustive switch in `stageEvents` fails until the `cast` case is added.

## Open questions

- These choices are in the ruling for a person to confirm:
  - a death with no killer and no actor counts for nobody;
  - the seat that caused a death is the owner's opponent, not the controller's;
  - a `damage` that is not from the viewer's card clears the heal's source. The issue doesn't say what such damage does; clearing it stops an enemy Lifesteal's heal from being credited to the viewer's attacker.
- I couldn't run any tests while planning: the planner worktree has no dependencies installed.
- Medium fits: a new ruling and about 15 files, all in the web app and the spec.
assignment: build on `claude-2` (claude, `sonnet`, medium); review on `claude-2` (claude, `opus`, strong)

   ```ts
   /** R2648000: the seat whose side shows `instanceId` in the first of `views` that does; null for none or the sentinel (R97). */
   function seatOf(views: readonly (PlayerView | null)[], instanceId: string | null): PlayerId | null {
     if (instanceId === null || instanceId === HIDDEN_ID) return null;
     for (const view of views) {
       if (view === null) continue;
       for (const side of [view.you, view.opponent]) {
         if (cardsOnSide(side).some((card) => card.instanceId === instanceId)) return side.player;
       }
     }
     return null;
   }

   /**
    * R2648000: a death counts (`destroyed` for the viewer's card, `defeated` for the opponent's) only when the
    * seat across from its owner caused it: its `killerId` names a card on that side (in the view before the
    * batch, else this one), or the last `cardPlayed`, `activated`, `trapFired` or `attackDeclared` before it in
    * the batch was that seat's (a destroy Spell names no killer, R89). Never after a `crumbled` of the same
    * card (Brittle), nor when the owner's side acted last with no killer of the other's (a Tribute, a
    * Sacrifice, its own sweeper), nor with no actor and no killer.
    */
   export function countDeaths(log: GameLog, view: PlayerView, fresh: readonly GameEvent[], before: PlayerView | null): GameLog {
     const views = [before, view];
     const crumbled = new Set<string>();
     let actor: PlayerId | null = null;
     let next = log;
     for (const event of fresh) {
       if (event.type === "cardPlayed" || event.type === "activated") {
         actor = event.player;
       } else if (event.type === "trapFired") {
         actor = event.controller;
       } else if (event.type === "attackDeclared") {
         actor = seatOf(views, event.attackerId);
       } else if (event.type === "crumbled") {
         crumbled.add(event.instanceId);
       } else if (event.type === "destroyed") {
         const id = readable(event.defId);
         const foe = opponentOf(event.owner);
         if (id === null || crumbled.has(event.instanceId)) continue;
         if (seatOf(views, event.killerId) !== foe && actor !== foe) continue;
         next = logWith(next, event.owner === view.viewer ? "destroyed" : "defeated", id);
       }
     }
     return next;
   }
   ```

   /** R2648000: the card's catalog type is Unit. */
   function isUnit(id: string): boolean {
     return CATALOG[id]?.type === "Unit";
   }

   /** R2648000: either face of the card prints one of `kinds`. */
   function prints(id: string, ...kinds: KeywordKind[]): boolean {
     const def = CATALOG[id];
     return def !== undefined && kinds.some((kind) => hasKeyword(def.base.keywords, kind) || hasKeyword(def.radiant.keywords, kind));
   }

   /** R2648000: a lunge is a Unit's or an Animated card's; a Spell or Field Spell casts, a Trap or Field Trap is revealed. Anything else is kept. */
   export function animationFor(defId: string, wanted: StageAnimation): StageAnimation {

     if (wanted !== "lunge" || type === undefined || type === "Unit" || prints(defId, "Animated", "Animated on your turn")) return wanted;
     return type === "Trap" || type === "Field Trap" ? "trap" : "cast";
   }

## Risks

- **Hidden information (R97).** `seatOf` and `defIdOn` read only `cardsOnSide`, which leaves out face-down cards, the opponent's hand and the sentinel.
- **Old totals are not migrated.** This is the issue's rule.
- **The first screen (R1584000).** `showcase.ts` must import only types from `showcaseStage.ts`. `animationFor` uses `showcase.ts`'s own `CATALOG`.
- **More tests may break.** Any tally that expects The Record, Unbreakable with fewer than 5 plays, or Hot Streak without wins will fail. Run the whole suite and fix the data.
- **TypeScript.** The exhaustive switch in `stageEvents` fails until the `cast` case is added.
